en.t: Ah, it smells wonderful, truly wonderful.

units.source_text: 说着，他咂了咂嘴，“这样可以养神。

en.t: As he said this, he smacked his lips and said, This can refresh the spirit.

units.source_text: 你想给我买好茶，又怕我喝多了，对身体不好，

en.t: You wanted to buy me good tea, but you were also afraid that if I drank too much, it would be bad for my health,

units.source_text: 所以才让我喝粗茶的吧。”

en.t: so that is why you let me drink coarse tea instead, isn't it?
